"""Slug generation helpers."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re

MAX_LENGTH = 40

_DISALLOWED = re.compile(r'[^a-z0-9 -]')
_SEPARATORS = re.compile(r'[ -]+')


def slugify(title: str) -> str:
    """Return a URL-friendly slug for ``title``.

    The title is lowercased, ``&`` becomes `` and ``, characters other than ASCII
    letters, digits, spaces and hyphens are dropped, runs of spaces and hyphens
    collapse into a single hyphen, leading and trailing hyphens are stripped, and
    the result is truncated to 40 characters (without leaving a trailing hyphen).
    """
    slug = title.lower()
    slug = slug.replace('&', ' and ')
    slug = _DISALLOWED.sub('', slug)
    slug = _SEPARATORS.sub('-', slug)
    slug = slug.strip('-')
    if len(slug) > MAX_LENGTH:
        slug = slug[:MAX_LENGTH].rstrip('-')
    return slug
